# For admins
The mode is the cvar wf.mapping_mode.enabled. Turning it off autosaves and closes every session and sends everyone to the lobby. The limits are cvars under wf.mapping_mode.
## Watching sessions
Admins see [bold]Observe[/bold] in the lobby. It puts you on a private admin map. From there tpto with a player's name reaches any mapper, or use wf_mappingmode_tp. [bold]Return to lobby[/bold] in the Mapping window brings you back.
An admin with the Mapping flag can edit any session's map and isn't held to the limits. The mapping command and the Tools tab's [bold]Save / load maps...[/bold] stay admin only.
## Commands
All need the Mapping flag and are admin logged.
[bold]wf_mappingmode_list[/bold] Every session with its code, owner, members, maps, unsaved changes and last save. [bold]wf_mappingmode_tp[/bold] code Go to a session's ground level. [bold]wf_mappingmode_close[/bold] code Autosave a session to its owner's library and close it. [bold]wf_mappingmode_kick[/bold] player Remove a player from their session. [bold]wf_mappingmode_save[/bold] code Save a session to its owner's library. [bold]wf_mappingmode_purge[/bold] code prototype Delete every entity of one prototype on a session's maps. For things that slipped past the limits. Players and observers stay.
